identity.note: This packet feeds EMBEDDED-AGENT-DEC-01. It does not approve Ports, Skeleton, RED, or production work.

intent.problem: EluSlot should host interactive Claude Code / Codex sessions (IDE-style) while preserving project binding, permission prompts, cancellation, and evidence gates. Existing ProcessPort is a one-shot CLI output drain, not an interactive terminal or chat session boundary.
intent.scope: Read-only mode comparison (PTY terminal vs native panel), ProcessPort gap inventory, host capability facts, proposed session ownership + UI schema drafts, and DEC-01 decision options. No production Port or adapter changes.
out_of_scope: new PTY dependency or crate adoption
live Claude Code / Codex auth or session
VS Code extension embedding into Tauri webview
session persistence / resume (unless owner later chooses)
assumptions_unapproved: Owner still chooses first feasibility slice (PTY fixture vs native panel).
Existing single active Run / evidence acceptance gates remain the product authority until a separate session model is approved.
Provider conversation execution is never product acceptance.

EA-A_integrated_terminal_PTY.name: Integrated terminal (PTY)
EA-A_integrated_terminal_PTY.proposal: Web terminal view -> proposed session/input boundary -> PTY adapter -> official Agent CLI (or local interactive fixture first).
requires: process and session cleanup on panel close
pros: Closest to real CLI UX; proves OS interactive capability early
Can use a benign local interactive fixture without Agent auth
Surfaces ProcessPort gaps concretely before provider choice
cons: Needs new seam (ProcessPort cannot absorb PTY without explicit redesign)
Permission/diff UX remains CLI-native; product cards harder
Windows ConPTY vs Unix PTY platform choice still open

EA-B_native_agent_panel.name: Native Agent panel
EA-B_native_agent_panel.proposal: EluSlot chat/session/approval/diff UI -> shared application session boundary -> provider adapters (Codex App Server documented; Claude Code headless / Agent SDK documented).
requires: shared task/evidence gates with CLI path
pros: Structured events instead of raw terminal bytes
Aligns with documented App Server / programmatic CLI paths
cons: Larger first slice: protocol, auth, UI schema, and ownership
Provider runtime differences still unvalidated live
Does not by itself prove OS interactive terminal capability
EA-B_native_agent_panel.processport_fit: ORTHOGONAL — uses provider protocol adapters, not ProcessPort stdin

processport_gaps.source_of_truth_note: Facts below are planning inventory from prior decision/process packets and DEC-01 review evidence. This PLAN card does not re-open ProcessPort production APIs.

existing_surface.observation: ProcessOutput stdout/stderr text plus StreamCompletion Open/Eof/Error (process-lifecycle slice)
existing_surface.consumers: EXEC CliAgentAdapter / ActiveRun via AgentPort start_run / poll_chunks / cancel

gaps_for_embedded_interactive.detail: Documented behavior: stdin started null / non-interactive; cannot feed keystrokes or prompt answers to a TTY-oriented Agent CLI.
No cols/rows or window-size signal on the port; web terminal cannot drive PTY geometry.
StdProcess owns piped Child readers for drain semantics, not a PTY master. Interactive terminal needs a different driven adapter and likely a distinct port.

gaps_for_embedded_interactive.gap: Cancel is direct-child + drain, not session lifecycle
gaps_for_embedded_interactive.detail: Process cancel + post-exit drain prove CLI run honesty; they do not model session disconnect, resume, or panel-close semantics.
ProcessPort carries opaque text streams. Approval cards require structured session events above the process adapter.

explicit_non_goals: Do not extend ProcessPort with stdin/resize in this PLAN.
Do not treat process-lifecycle StreamCompletion approval as authorization for PTY.
Any new interactive port remains PROPOSED until DEC-01 + follow-on architecture approval.

available_today: AgentPort start_run / poll_chunks / cancel for CLI-style runs
Single active Run projection in UI; busy guard on duplicate Assign (ui-active-run)
HOST cancel acknowledgment + continued poll until terminal (process-lifecycle integration A)
Task / evidence acceptance gates remain product authority for CLI path
Outbound MCP / dispatch-mode planning exists separately; not the same as embedded interactive host
not_available_or_unproven: Native chat/session/approval panel wired to provider protocols
Session create bound to project/worktree as first-class Host authority
Live Claude Code or Codex embedded session
VS Code extension host inside Tauri webview (explicitly not assumed)
Auth store / token lifecycle for embedded providers

architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A1 System context: Operator uses EluSlot Agent UI. Application owns project/task binding, permission routing, leases, and evidence acceptance. Provider (or PTY fixture) owns conversation/tool execution only.
architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A2 Hexagonal view:
See diagram_a.
EluSlot Agent UI (projection)
  -> SessionInputPort [PROPOSED]
  -> Application: bind project/worktree + permission routing + leases + cancel/finalize
  -> Session/Provider output ports [PROPOSED]
       <- PTY adapter (EA-A) OR Codex App Server / Claude Code adapters (EA-B)
  -> Existing task/evidence gates (unchanged authority)
Domain stays free of OS/PTY/SDK types.
architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A3 Dependency view:
See diagram_b.
UI/HOST -> Application session boundary -> proposed ports
adapters -> ports
EXEC/ProcessPort remains the CLI run path; must not silently become the interactive session path.
Forbidden: Domain -> PTY/SDK; UI -> mutable session authority; provider completion -> auto green.

A4 Responsibilities.ui: Projection + explicit user actions (prompt, approve/deny, cancel, close).
A4 Responsibilities.application: Session identity, project binding, permission routing, cancel/finalize, lease/evidence handoff.
A4 Responsibilities.pty_adapter: OS interactive process only (fixture or CLI); no product acceptance.
A4 Responsibilities.provider_adapters: Codex App Server / Claude Code protocol translation only.
A4 Responsibilities.processport: Unchanged CLI drain path; out of interactive session ownership.

architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A5 Input ports: PROPOSED SessionInputPort (create/bind, send_user_input or write_bytes, resize, respond_permission, cancel, close). Existing AgentPort unchanged for CLI runs.
architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A6 Output ports: PROPOSED session event stream (stdout/bytes or structured messages, permission requests, status). ProcessPort unchanged.
architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A8 Driven adapters: PTY/ConPTY fixture adapter (EA-A) and/or provider protocol adapters (EA-B) — none approved for production yet.
architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A9 Dependency direction: Adapters depend on ports; application depends on ports; Domain has no OS/provider types.
architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A10 State ownership: Application owns session registry and project binding. Adapter owns OS/provider connection. UI never owns authoritative session state.
architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A11 Mutation boundary: Only application finalizes session and routes permissions. Adapter emits observations. UI sends intents.
architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A12 Transaction boundary: Session create must bind project/worktree before spawn. Close/cancel must not leave orphan processes. Approval is exactly-once per request id.
architecture_A1_A14_PROPOSED.A13 External boundary: OS PTY/child; Codex App Server; Claude Code CLI/SDK; user auth stores. No VS Code extension host assumption.
A14 Forbidden dependencies: UI -> direct process kill or token store mutation
ProcessPort silent stdin/resize extension without new approved port
provider done -> board green / evidence auto-accept
silent project switch on existing session

diagram_a_hexagonal:
EluSlot Agent UI [driving]
  -> SessionInputPort [PROPOSED]
  -> Application (bind + permissions + leases + finalize)
  -> Provider/Session output [PROPOSED]
  <- PTY adapter (EA-A) | Codex/Claude adapters (EA-B)
  -> Existing task/evidence gates
ProcessPort/AgentPort CLI path remains parallel, not reused as interactive session.
Domain: no OS/PTY/SDK.
diagram_b_ownership_and_gaps:
Ownership:
  Provider/fixture = conversation + tool execution
  Application = task/run/session authority + approvals + evidence gates
  UI = projection + explicit actions

ProcessPort gaps blocking EA-A reuse:
  GAP-PP-01 no stdin
  GAP-PP-02 no resize
  GAP-PP-03 no PTY ownership
  GAP-PP-04 cancel != session lifecycle
  GAP-PP-05 no permission channel

Deps: UI/HOST -> App -> ports <- adapters
EXEC may keep ProcessPort for CLI; must not import PTY types into Domain.

roles.provider_or_fixture: Owns conversation bytes/messages and tool execution inside its process or protocol.
roles.application: Owns session id, project/worktree binding, permission grant/deny authority, cancel/finalize, and handoff into existing evidence gates.
roles.ui: Owns only projection and explicit operator intents.

lifecycle_draft: Closed (panel close ends session in recommended first slice — no resume)

invariants_draft.meaning: No session spawn without bound project/worktree.
Permission prompts never auto-approve; approve/deny reaches exactly one matching session request.
Agent/provider completion is not product acceptance; evidence gates remain authoritative.
Do not silently switch project on an existing session; rebind requires explicit close+create or approved migrate policy.
Cancel/close must not leave orphan interactive processes; cleanup is part of finalize.
CLI AgentPort path and embedded session path share evidence gates but must not share mutable run authority without an approved model.

controls: Agent selector (Claude Code / Codex) — deferred until after feasibility if DEC chooses A
Permission and question cards (native panel; CLI-native for pure PTY)
Diff/evidence view (native panel; deferred on first PTY fixture)
Cancel / close (first slice: close ends session; no resume)
rules: Agent completion is not product acceptance
do not silently switch projects on existing session

A.summary: PTY feasibility first with one benign local interactive fixture (not live Agent auth). Prove input/resize/interrupt/close with project binding; panel close ends session; no persistence/resume; no approval auto-accept. After capability proof, choose one provider. Defer native chat/diff/permission framework.
A.follow_on: Bounded fixture UI schema + two architecture views already drafted here; choose Win ConPTY vs Unix PTY research scope only after owner selects A; new PTY seam still needs explicit review before Skeleton.

B.summary: Native provider panel first only if owner prioritizes that UX and selects a concrete provider protocol (Codex App Server or Claude Code programmatic path). Larger first slice than PTY fixture.
B.follow_on: Lock one provider protocol + auth + structured event schema before Skeleton; ProcessPort remains untouched.

decision_feed_DEC_01.exact_owner_question: 是否先做 PTY 最小可行性（只本機互動測試程式、輸入／resize／中斷／關閉；關閉即結束，不保存 session、不自動准權），再選 Claude Code／Codex 真正接入？
acceptance_for_later_implementation: Claude Code and Codex evaluated separately when selected
interactive input and streamed output proven
restart/disconnect recovery specified and tested if owner later allows resume
CLI and embedded paths share task/evidence gates

limitations: No claim that a VS Code extension can be installed directly into a Tauri webview
No PTY, SDK runtime, or authentication choice approved
No live Agent started; no provider integration tested
No production Port changes in this PLAN
Planning packet is not architecture approval and not board green

scenarios.title: Refuse spawn without project bind
scenarios.given: Agent UI is idle and no project/worktree is bound
scenarios.when: Operator attempts to start an embedded session
scenarios.then: No process or provider session is created and the UI remains unconfigured or idle with an explicit bind requirement

scenarios.title: PTY fixture input and resize (if DEC A)
scenarios.given: A bound project and a benign local interactive fixture session
scenarios.when: Operator types input and resizes the terminal
scenarios.then: Fixture receives input and resize; streamed output appears; no Agent auth is required

scenarios.title: Close ends session without resume (first slice)
scenarios.given: An active embedded fixture or session panel
scenarios.then: Session finalizes, interactive process is cleaned up, and reopen does not silently resume prior conversation

scenarios.title: Permission never auto-approves (native panel path)
scenarios.given: A session emits a permission request
scenarios.when: No operator approve/deny has been issued
scenarios.then: The tool action does not proceed and the UI stays in waiting-for-approval

scenarios.title: Provider done is not product acceptance
scenarios.when: Evidence gates have not accepted the work
scenarios.then: Product acceptance remains pending and board/evidence state is unchanged by provider completion alone
